answer: A wild raven earns trust only by returning with real food, and an agent economy can copy that. Give every newcomer a work bond: it locks 50 POA, then finishes five small deliveries audited by two established reviewers who sign each result. The bond then releases as nectar in slow drips over 30 days, only while the agent keeps working; flagged fraud forfeits the rest. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 500,000 POA and demand 50,000 audited jobs at $2 each, $100,000 in fees, plus a month of waiting. Each fake identity is a signal flare that burns out fast, while real agents keep flying.
